Specification.Keyboard:
61 standard size keys
Touch Response: Sensitivity 3 types, off
Specification.External Input Effects: Center cancel (vocal cut) for input from the Audio In jack
Specification.Registration: Maximum 128 setups (8 setups x 16 banks), registration sequence
Specification.Tone Editing:
Preset tone editing, DSP editing
Memory for storage of edited tones (up to 100)
Specification.Rhythm Editing:
New rhythm creation, rhythm editing
Memory for storage of created/edited rhythms (up to 50)
Specification.Controllers: Pitch bend wheel, TOUCH On/OFF button, PORTAMENTO button

Tones.Other: Layer, split (configurable split point, lower point, chord point settings)

System Effects.DSP: 100 types (Can be applied to user tones using DSP editing.), DSP tones

Song Bank.USB Memory Songs: Playback of standard MIDI files (SMF format 0/1), CASIO MIDI files (CMF format) on a USB flash drive are supported.

Mixer function.Affected Parts: Sound source parts, microphone input part
Mixer function.Parameters: Part on/off, volume, pan, reverb send, chorus send, delay send

MIDI Recorder.Keyboard Performance Recording: 10 songs, 17 tracks (1 system track, 16 solo tracks)
MIDI Recorder.Editing Mode: Song editing, track editing, event editing, step input

Other Functions.Part coarse tune: For each keyboard part, ±2 octaves (-24 to 0 to +24 semitones)

Inputs/Outputs.Audio Input Jack: Stereo mini jack/Input impedance 9 kΩ, Input sensitivity 200 mV

Power Supply.Auto Power Off: Approximately 30 minutes after last operation; Can be disabled.
